mentions.name: Lua engine feed generator
mentions.description: An experimental tool that uses a Lua engine to build feeds for websites that don't support them, with the Lua scripts generated by AI as a one-off. It works reasonably well but isn't ready for prime time yet.
mentions.source_excerpt: Otherwise, I’ve been playing around with a Lua engine to build feeds for websites that don’t support them, using AI to build the Lua as a once-off. It works reasonably well, but isn’t ready for prime time just yet.
